messages.subject: Ordering fill legend with geom_bar
parts:
I'm not sure if this is a bug, or if I'm just approaching this the wrong way. Reproducible data via dput() is at the bottom.

I'm using 0.9.0, and I thought that having the variable that I map to fill in geom_bar would control the ordering of the colors in the legend, but that doesn't appear to work in this case. Note that the variables lev and lev1 are both ordered factors, only the first one, lev, has digits prepended that appears to force the correct ordering.

Using lev1 doesn't work:

ggplot() + 

facet_grid(var1~var3) +

geom_bar(data = subset(dat,!below),

aes(x = var2,y = tot,fill = lev1)) + 

geom_bar(data = subset(dat,below),

aes(x = var2,y = -tot,fill = lev1)) +

labs(x = NULL,y = NULL,fill = "") + 

scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(6,"Blues")[3:6]) +

opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle = 90))

but replacing lev1 with lev orders the legend correctly. Am I missing something really simple?


- Joran
